images.title: Crossing point of circles
images.purpose: Show that the crossing point A of two circles of radius 5 cm is 5 cm from both centres B and C.
images.composition: Two overlapping circles centred, with the point A at the top crossing.
images.exact_structure: Two circles of the same radius 5 cm: one centred at B (left) teal #0072B2, one centred at C (right) amber #E69F00, with B and C 5 cm apart on a horizontal grey #6B7280 line. The circles cross above the line at A, marked with a reddish purple #CC79A7 dot. Straight segments BA and CA drawn grey, each labelled 5 cm. Exactly 2 circles, 3 points, 2 segments.

images.takeaway: A is 5 cm from B and 5 cm from C.
images.description: Two 5 cm circles around B and C meeting at A, with BA and CA each marked 5 cm.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at A and say its distance to each centre.

image_decisions.why: Two circles and one crossing point carry the idea.
